scope: 0.5B ClayCode cognition Together BYOM paid-create boundary only

problem.preflight_semantics: model_limits plus estimate_price validate the selected Together template and corpus pricing/admission but do not validate the from_hf_model checkpoint/template pair; BYOM compatibility must remain OPEN until create accepts the exact pair and the job reaches training
problem.duplicate_create_risk: the previous --create path had no campaign identity or account-side duplicate guard, so an accepted remote create followed by an ambiguous client transport failure could invite a blind retry and a second paid job

mechanism.campaign_identity: SHA-256 over exact train/validation digests and full training configuration including from_hf_model/template
mechanism.operator_gate: CLAYCOG_CREATE_FINGERPRINT must equal the complete deterministic preflight fingerprint before --create proceeds
mechanism.account_duplicate_guard: deterministic campaign suffix is searched in Together fine-tuning job listings before remote file allocation and again immediately before billed create
mechanism.ambiguous_outcome_rule: never blind-retry create; list/retrieve account jobs and resolve the deterministic campaign suffix first
mechanism.compatibility_reporting: template full-FT admission is separated from BYOM checkpoint compatibility

isolated_regression.notes: No provider network call and no secret required by these safety tests.

unusual_experiment.name: ambiguous_create_timeout_retry
unusual_experiment.intervention: simulate remote fine-tune create being durably registered as pending while the local client observes only a TimeoutError
unusual_experiment.falsifier: a second launch is unsafe if it can pass duplicate admission and create a second campaign job

next_exact_step: With TOGETHER_API_KEY mounted only in an authorized execution environment: run preflight, capture the exact campaign fingerprint and server estimate, verify the account has no matching suffix, bind CLAYCOG_CREATE_FINGERPRINT to that exact fingerprint, create exactly one job if the <=USD18 gate and API admission pass, then retrieve that exact job and observe its training/error state. On any ambiguous create transport result, resolve the account-side suffix before any retry.
